subject: Inference go/no-go criteria + runbook for production ramp
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionht.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Inference go/no-go criteria + runbook for production ramp

Hi Evan / Sofia —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. To make the production ramp deterministic from an ops and SRE perspective, attached is a concise runbook that captures the proposed go/no-go acceptance criteria, the load plan we'll run with LoadLabs, and the artifact template we'll use to share evidence with your security and platform teams.

High level proposal (summary):
- Target latency SLO: p95 <= 180ms for 32-token responses, under sustained concurrency of 80 QPS for the core endpoint.
- Throughput goal: sustain 4k tokens/sec aggregate across model pool.
- Tail target: p99 <= 420ms during steady-state.
- Error rate: <0.5% 5xx for the duration of the test window.
- Resource validation: <10% variance in GPU memory KPIs between baseline and ramp.

Runbook highlights (in attached RI-runbook-v1.pdf):
1) Pre-test checklist (credentials, routing, warm-up cache).
2) Three-phase load plan: smoke (10m), ramp (30m), soak (2h).
3) Traffic mix: 70% generation (short prompts), 20% long-context (512 tokens), 10% embeddings.
4) Abort conditions and rollback steps with responsible owners.

We propose running the official load window next Tuesday (12/07) starting 09:00 PT. LoadLabs will run the k6 script attached (k6-load-script-orion.js). We’ll collect token-level cost, tail latencies, and KV cache hit rates; results will be shared in the benchmark template (orion-benchmark-template.xlsx).

Please review the attachment and call out any additional acceptance checks your compliance team needs (audit logs, request/response redaction proof, encryption-at-rest evidence). If that looks good, confirm the 12/07 slot and the primary point of contact for your infra team.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Customer Success
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

Attachments: RI-runbook-v1.pdf (10 pages), k6-load-script-orion.js (load script), orion-benchmark-template.xlsx (evidence template)

From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionht.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@orionht.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inference go/no-go criteria + runbook for production ramp

Thanks Aditya — this looks thorough, appreciate the clear abort criteria. A few notes from our side:

- Our primary constraint is tail latency under peaky traffic from the triage UI. Can we add an additional p99.9 check for the 10-minute spike window (target p99.9 <= 700ms)?
- Can you include a short section proving request/response redaction for PHI fields (we have to satisfy our privacy team)? A short walkthrough or sample logs would be enough.
- We'll need the results in both the template and a one-page executive readout for our SOC — can your team produce the one-pager?

Sofia is our infra lead and will own the run on our side — cc'd. We can confirm the slot for 12/07 at 09:00 PT as proposed.

Evan
VP, Platform Engineering
Orion HealthTech
evancole@orionht.com
(617) 555-2424

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionht.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@orionht.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inference go/no-go criteria + runbook for production ramp

Thanks Evan — noted and we can accommodate those asks. Quick updates before Tuesday's run: 

- Added p99.9 spike check (target <= 700ms) to the abort conditions and post-run verification checklist.
- Included a PHI redaction verification checklist: sample request/response anonymization, automated redaction tests during the soak, and a short manual verification step for the SOC one-pager.
- Monica will produce the one-page executive readout immediately after the soak; we'll deliver both the filled template and the one-pager by EOD the test day.

Operational plan (final):
- 09:00 PT: warm-up + baseline measurements (30m)
- 09:30 PT: smoke + functional sanity (10m)
- 09:40 PT: controlled ramp to target QPS over 30m
- 10:10 PT: 2h soak at target load
- Post-run: 45m evidence collection and immediate triage on any aborts

On our side: Karthik will own kernel/config telemetry and will be on-call for any runtime fallbacks; Monica will lead the result synthesis and exec readout. Please confirm attendees for the call and whether your SREs want remote access to the observability dashboard during the run.

Cheers,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: updated RI-runbook-v1.pdf (changes: p99.9, PHI checklist).

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionht.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@orionht.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inference go/no-go criteria + runbook for production ramp

Folks — quick post-run summary (raw numbers below). Full evidence and the one-page readout attached; filled template is in the Drive link. High-level: PASS with two action items we agreed to track.

Key results (soak period 10:10–12:10 PT):
- p95 latency (32-token): 142ms
- p99 latency (32-token): 368ms
- p99.9 (10-minute spike window): 650ms (within agreed 700ms)
- Sustained tokens/sec: 4,080 tokens/sec
- 5xx error rate: 0.12% (mostly transient backend timeout at 10:17 — auto-retry handled)
- KV cache hit-rate: 86% after warm-up
- GPU memory variance vs baseline: +4.6% (within tolerance)

Action items (owners):
1) Karthik: add a short kernel-level trace for the 10:17 transient; deliver a micro-report by 12/10.
2) Aditya/Monica: deliver the SOC one-pager + filled template to your compliance mailbox; expect by EOD today.

Links / artifacts:
- Filled template: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-orion-runbook
- One-pager: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-orion-exec
- Raw load logs (s3 presigned): https://s3.redwoodai.com/orion/20271207/raw-logs.zip (access given to evan.cole@orionht.com)

Thanks everyone — happy to schedule a short review tomorrow if you want to walk the traces.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Onboarding
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodai.com

Attachments: orion-benchmark-template.xlsx (completed), RI-onepager-orion.pdf (exec summary)
